# Vendored from raspberrypi/pico-examples

Copied unmodified from https://github.com/raspberrypi/pico-examples at commit
`0d62f75bafc2c8120d3276c3343d1a9195e909e9`, directory `pico_w/wifi/access_point/`.

- `dhcpserver/`: DHCP server for the Wi-Fi access point. MIT License (Damien P. George, from MicroPython), see `dhcpserver/LICENSE`.
- `dnsserver/`: DNS server that answers every query with the access point address, which makes phones and laptops open the guide as a captive portal. BSD-3-Clause (Raspberry Pi Ltd), see `dnsserver/LICENSE`.

Do not edit these files; update them by copying a newer version from pico-examples.
